title: Implement Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Learn the key concepts and strategies for implementing continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) in Microsoft Fabric.

title: Monitor Activities in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Learn how to use the monitoring hub in Microsoft Fabric to track activity status, investigate failures, and view historical run data. Explore how Activator responds to Fabric job events with automated alerts and actions.

title: Secure Data Access in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Implement workspace roles, item permissions, and OneLake security roles to control data access in Microsoft Fabric.

title: Administer a Microsoft Fabric Environment
summary: Learn how to configure and manage a Microsoft Fabric environment, including tenant settings, domain setup, admin delegation, user licensing, and platform monitoring.

title: Discover and Connect to Data in OneLake
summary: Browse and connect to data using Microsoft OneLake's unified storage. Discover data across workspaces with the OneLake catalog, create shortcuts to reference existing data, and explore streaming sources in Real-Time hub.

title: Get started with lakehouses in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Lakehouses in Microsoft Fabric combine data lake flexibility with data warehouse analytics. Learn how to create, load, and query a lakehouse on a single platform.

title: Get Started with Data Warehouses in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Understand the key components and design considerations for implementation of data warehouses in Microsoft Fabric.

title: Get started with Real-Time Intelligence in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Real-Time Intelligence in Microsoft Fabric has capabilities that help you ingest, process, store, visualize, and act on data in motion to gain immediate insights from events as they happen.

title: Choose Data Stores in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Evaluate lakehouse, warehouse, and eventhouse options in Microsoft Fabric to select the appropriate analytical data store for different business scenarios based on data format, query language, write patterns, and team skills.

title: Design Dimensional Models for Analytics in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Learn dimensional schema types, fact and dimension table design, and slowly changing dimension patterns for analytics workloads in Microsoft Fabric.

title: Transform Data Using Dataflows Gen2 in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Apply low-code transformations using Power Query in Dataflows Gen2 to prepare analytical data for downstream consumption.

title: Transform Data Using Notebooks in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Use Fabric notebooks to transform data with Spark SQL and PySpark, connecting to lakehouses, warehouses, and other data stores.

title: Transform Data Using T-SQL in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Use T-SQL in Microsoft Fabric warehouses to transform and query data, create reusable views and stored procedures, and build dimensional tables.

title: Use Eventstream in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Eventstream in Real-Time Intelligence (RTI) enables you to ingest, transform, and route real-time data.

title: Work with real-time data in an Eventhouse in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Microsoft Fabric provides a scalable and flexible store for real-time data.

title: Load data into a Microsoft Fabric data warehouse
summary: Learn how to load data into a Microsoft Fabric warehouse using data pipelines, T-SQL, and Dataflow Gen2.

title: Query a data warehouse in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Learn to query a Microsoft Fabric data warehouse using the SQL query editor, visual query editor, and SQL Server Management Studio.

title: Monitor a Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse
summary: A data warehouse is a vital component of an enterprise analytics solution. It's important to learn how to monitor a data warehouse so you can better understand the activity that occurs in it.

title: Secure a Microsoft Fabric data warehouse
summary: Learn the key concepts and strategies for protecting sensitive data in Microsoft Fabric data warehouses.

title: Ingest Data with Dataflows in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Data ingestion is crucial in analytics. Microsoft Fabric's Data Factory offers Dataflows for visually creating multi-step data ingestion and transformation using Power Query Online.

title: Orchestrate Processes and Data Movement with Microsoft Fabric
summary: Use Data Factory pipelines in Microsoft Fabric

title: Use Apache Spark in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Apache Spark is a core technology for large-scale data analytics. Microsoft Fabric provides support for Spark clusters, enabling you to analyze and process data at scale.

title: Work with Delta Lake Tables in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Tables in a Microsoft Fabric lakehouse are based on the Delta Lake technology commonly used in Apache Spark. By using the enhanced capabilities of delta tables, you can create advanced analytics solutions.

title: Organize a Fabric Lakehouse Using Medallion Architecture Design
summary: Explore the potential of the medallion architecture design in Microsoft Fabric. Organize and transform your data across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers of a lakehouse for optimized analytics.

title: Govern Analytics Data in Microsoft Fabric
summary: Implement Fabric-native governance practices including data classification, sensitivity labels, endorsement, and documentation to ensure data assets are trustworthy and governed for both human and AI consumption.

title: Optimize Semantic Model Performance
summary: Diagnose and fix semantic model and report performance issues. Use Performance analyzer to identify bottlenecks, optimize DAX calculations, reduce cardinality, and implement aggregations to improve query speed.

title: Enforce Semantic Model Security
summary: Implement row-level security, object-level security, and dynamic security patterns to protect sensitive data in semantic models.

title: Manage the Semantic Model Development Lifecycle
summary: Manage semantic models through their full development lifecycle. Create reusable assets, version-control with Git, inspect and validate with the XMLA endpoint and SemPy, deploy through pipelines, and maintain with monitoring and impact analysis.
